decision_rule: 1. Any registered case invalid or missing -> INCOMPLETE (name each case and failed gate, with that gate's pre-named next step; no threshold or rule change).
2. Dhat_R > 1 -> INNER_UNRESOLVED (next step: raise inner panel orders on the adopted grid; needs a reviewed prep successor with node budget >= 116 and its own review).

3. No shape passes -> NOT_CONVERGED (next step: extend the shape with the smallest Dhat_A(3,4) to 5 and 6 /kpc with the same order-6 unit outer panels, 108/120 nodes per axis; needs a prep successor with node budget >= 120 and a per-call cap >= 6 GiB, under separate review).

4. Two or more shapes pass but some passing pair differs at K=4 by more than 2*tau_i on any row -> NOT_CONVERGED (SHAPE_DISAGREEMENT; same next step, shape with the smallest Dhat_A(3,4) among the passing shapes).

5. Otherwise ADOPT A*: let m = the m4_statistic of each passing shape at K=4. If any passing shape's m is null, candidates = all passing shapes. Else candidates = passing shapes with m <= 1.10 * min m. A* = the candidate with the smallest Dhat_A(3,4); exact ties go to the registered order cube, sphere, cylinder. Adopted at k_max = 4 /kpc on grid G4.

6. Carried numerical uncertainty per row: u_i = |v_i(A*,4) - v_i(A*,3)| + |v_i(R) - v_i(C2)| + max over passing shapes A of |v_i(A,4) - v_i(A*,4)| km/s, reported with the adoption (with u_i/tau_i and u_i/sigma_i).
gate_V1: Read the case's status and reasons. (i) monitor stop (wall/RSS/output cap): rerun the same spec in a fresh outdir with the cap raised under a separate approval; (ii) FAILED_AT_STAGE with a bracket miss in a column pass: the D7 recovery; (iii) BLOCKED ROUTE_A_ITERATION_NOT_4 or ROUTE_A_NOT_CONVERGED_AT_ITERATION_4 (deterministic): the matrix stops as BLOCKED_ROUTE_A at that grid; next step is a reviewed route-B successor that accepts the converged route-A iteration, under separate review; (iv) BLOCKED on admission (seed/identity): regenerate the admitted spec from the cube outdir under the cube's driver and rerun; (v) any other FAILED or REFUSED: one rerun of the same spec; a second identical failure is reported as a deterministic defect for review.
P6_declared_recovery: On a bracket miss (FAILED_AT_STAGE in a column pass: bracket failure or 'no bracket source'): (1) widen only the missed columns' entries in the rule override block, recorded with the failed call's column enthalpies as evidence; (2) write a corrected base spec = anchor base spec with that one block changed; (3) rerun the failed call admitting its OWN route-A checkpoint, reference and body (admission checks parameters, not brackets); (4) regenerate EVERY case with --base-spec <corrected base spec> so the brackets block stays identical across cases (completed cases are rerun admitting their own prefixes). The corrected block, its sha and the reason are passed to the comparison with --bracket-recovery and recorded in the report. No threshold or rule changes.
shape_pass: Pass(A) iff cases (A,2),(A,3),(A,4) are valid AND Dhat_A(3,4) <= 1 AND Dhat_A(3,4) <= 0.5 * Dhat_A(2,3). With contraction ratio q <= 1/2 the geometric tail Dhat34*q/(1-q) <= Dhat34 <= 1, i.e. each row's remaining tail is at most tau_i; no tail is adopted.
